ABOUT R.K. PURI LAW

Experience informed by investigation.
Representation grounded in law.

R.K. Puri Law is a Jodhpur-based legal practice focused on criminal law, litigation, and related legal proceedings.

THE PRACTICE

Experience. Insight. Advocacy.

R.K. Puri Law is a Jodhpur-based, multidisciplinary litigation practice with a strong foundation in criminal law, criminal investigations, and courtroom advocacy.

Led by Rakesh Puri, a retired Additional Superintendent of Police with 35 years of distinguished police service and 11 years of criminal law practice, the firm brings together extensive investigative experience and practical legal knowledge.

The firm's approach is informed by a thorough understanding of criminal investigations, evidentiary procedures, trial preparation, and the complexities of judicial proceedings. This distinctive background enables the legal team to examine matters from both investigative and legal perspectives, developing strategies grounded in facts, evidence, and applicable law.

Multidisciplinary Litigation Capability

Supported by a team of associate advocates with experience across criminal, civil, constitutional, commercial, and regulatory law, R.K. Puri Law provides representation in a broad spectrum of legal proceedings.

The firm's practice extends to the Rajasthan High Court, District and Sessions Courts, Magistrate Courts, and specialised judicial forums, including courts dealing with NDPS, POCSO, anti-corruption, and other criminal matters.

Our Approach

At R.K. Puri Law, every matter is approached with careful legal analysis, attention to procedural detail, and a commitment to professional integrity. The firm emphasises thorough preparation, clear communication, and representation tailored to the individual circumstances of each case.

/investigation-expertise/.content:
Home/Investigation Expertise

SPECIALIZED CAPABILITY

Criminal Investigation Advisory & Evidence

A distinctive perspective bridging criminal investigation leadership with courtroom trial advocacy.

FIELD EXPERIENCE

5,000+ Investigations Handled & Supervised

A criminal case is largely won or lost during the investigation stage. A sound understanding of investigative procedure is crucial when assessing criminal allegations, evaluating evidence, identifying procedural irregularities, and preparing a robust legal defence.

During his 35-year police career culminating as Additional Superintendent of Police, Rakesh Puri personally investigated and supervised more than 5,000 cases. His experience encompasses murder, kidnapping, forgery, crimes against women, economic crime, and complex Indian Penal Code offences, as well as specialized operational work with JDVVNL and the Anti-Terrorist Squad (ATS), Jodhpur.

What Our Investigation Advisory Delivers

  • Scrutiny of Police Records: In-depth examination of First Information Reports (FIRs), daily general diaries, arrest memos, search and seizure rosters, and site plans.
  • Evidentiary Vulnerabilities: Identifying breaks in the chain of custody, delayed recording of witness statements, and procedural breaches under CrPC/BNSS.
  • Forensics & Medical Jurisprudence: Expert evaluation of post-mortem reports, medico-legal certificates (MLCs), ballistic reports, DNA analysis, and chemical examination reports.
  • Electronic & Digital Evidence: Scrutinizing CDRs (Call Detail Records), tower location data, CCTV footage, mobile extractions, and compliance with certification mandates.
  • Witness Impeachment Strategy: Formulating precise cross-examination lines to reveal tutoring, contradictions, and material omissions.
  • Advisory for Fellow Advocates: Confidential collaboration with trial lawyers seeking specialized investigative analysis of complex case files.
Consult on Investigation Records ↗

Criminal Litigation & Defence

Criminal defence, trial proceedings, bail applications, and appellate remedies before Sessions Courts and the Rajasthan High Court.

APPROACH & EXPERIENCE

Investigation-Informed Courtroom Defence

R.K. Puri Law handles criminal proceedings at every stage of the criminal justice process—from pre-charge investigation scrutiny and remand proceedings to trial defence, bail applications, appeals, and revision petitions.

Drawing on Rakesh Puri's 35 years of senior police service and 11 years of criminal legal practice, the firm brings unmatched practical insight into the realities of criminal investigation. This enables the legal team to detect flaws in police procedures, scrutinize case diaries, challenge tainted seizure memos, and formulate compelling trial defence strategies.

Scope of Criminal Practice

  • Trial Advocacy: Defence representation across the Court of Sessions, Chief Judicial Magistrate, and Judicial Magistrate First Class courts.
  • Bail & Liberty: Pre-trial bail, regular bail, anticipatory bail, and interim protection before Sessions and High Court benches.
  • Charge-Sheet Scrutiny: Exhaustive review of police reports, statements under Section 161/164, and evidence exhibits.
  • Discharge Applications: Seeking discharge of accused where allegations are malicious or prima facie unsustainable.
  • Cross-Examination: Skillful cross-examination of eyewitnesses, investigating officers, and medical/forensic experts.
  • Criminal Appeals & Revisions: Challenging convictions, sentences, or irregular interlocutory orders before appellate courts.
  • Special Criminal Statutes: Representation in NDPS, POCSO, Anti-Corruption (PC Act), SC/ST (POA) Act, and CBI matters.

Home/Practice Areas/Writ Jurisdiction

PRACTICE AREA

Writ Petitions & Constitutional Remedies

Writ proceedings under Articles 226 and 227 of the Constitution of India before the High Court of Judicature for Rajasthan.

HIGH COURT JURISDICTION

Remedies Against Arbitrary State Action

R.K. Puri Law handles writ petitions and constitutional proceedings before the Rajasthan High Court at Jodhpur and Jaipur. Writ jurisdiction provides extraordinary legal remedies where fundamental rights or statutory duties have been infringed by public authorities, administrative bodies, or subordinate tribunals.

Led by Rakesh Puri with associate advocate Lucky Singh focusing on writ drafting and constitutional jurisprudence, the firm prepares meticulously grounded petitions supported by documentary proof and binding legal precedents.

Prerogative Writs Handled

  • Habeas Corpus: For the production of persons unlawfully detained or missing in police custody or unauthorized confinement.
  • Mandamus: Compelling statutory authorities and government officials to perform their mandatory legal duties.
  • Certiorari: Quashing illegal, unconstitutional, or jurisdictionally defective orders passed by administrative bodies or lower forums.
  • Prohibition: Restraining subordinate judicial or quasi-judicial bodies from exceeding their lawful jurisdiction.
  • Quo Warranto: Challenging the legal authority or eligibility of an individual holding a public office.
  • Criminal Writs & Quashing: Petitions under Article 226 / Section 482 for quashing malicious FIRs, protecting personal liberty, and ensuring fair investigation.
Enquire About High Court Writs ↗

FOUNDER PROFILE

Rakesh Kumar Puri

Advocate | Retired Additional Superintendent of Police. 35 years in police service and 11 years of criminal legal practice in Rajasthan.

Rakesh Kumar Puri Advocate · Retired Additional SP Connect on LinkedIn ↗

BIOGRAPHY & PROFESSIONAL JOURNEY

Decades in the Field. Applied in the Courtroom.

Rakesh Kumar Puri is a retired Additional Superintendent of Police with over 35 years of distinguished experience in policing, criminal investigation, and law enforcement. His extensive service, spanning the rank of Inspector of Police to Additional Superintendent of Police, has equipped him with exceptional practical knowledge of criminal investigations, evidence gathering, and the conduct of criminal trials.

During his police career, he served as Station House Officer (SHO) and Circle Officer in various districts of Rajasthan, as Additional Superintendent of Police with JDVVNL in Jodhpur, and as Additional Superintendent of Police with the Anti-Terrorist Squad (ATS), Jodhpur. Over 5,000 cases were investigated and supervised under his leadership, spanning murder, kidnapping, forgery, crimes against women, economic crime, and complex Indian Penal Code offences.

His exceptional service was recognized with more than 300 commendation certificates and commendation certificates with cash awards. During his service, he also delivered lectures on forensics, medical jurisprudence, women safety, and police administration, and attended multiple capsule trainings in the criminal justice system.

Legal Practice & High Court Advocacy

Graduating with a B.Com. LL.B. from Jai Narayan Vyas University, Jodhpur in 1979 and enrolled with the Bar Council of Rajasthan in 2016, he has over 11 years of dedicated criminal legal practice. Practising before the Rajasthan High Court (Criminal Benches, Writ Benches) and District & Sessions Courts, he handles criminal trials, appeals, revisions, quashing petitions, and writ litigation.

Combining decades of field experience with substantial legal expertise, he offers a distinctive perspective that bridges the gap between criminal investigation and courtroom advocacy. He also leads a dedicated team of associate advocates handling civil, commercial, banking, cyber, and regulatory matters.

CORE TRIAL & LITIGATION SKILLS

Mastery Across Every Stage of Trial

01

Case Theory Formulation

Strategic formulation of defence or prosecution theory grounded in the statutory elements and factual record.

02

Charge Sheet Scrutiny

Microscopic analysis of investigation diaries, 161 statements, seizure memos, and procedural non-compliance.

03

Expert Cross-Examination

Rigorous cross-examination of forensic experts, ballistic analysts, and medical doctors on post-mortem and injury reports.

04

Electronic Evidence

Handling and challenging electronic evidence under Section 65B of the Evidence Act / BSA provisions and cyber data.

05

Witness Credibility

Impeaching witness credibility through prior contradictory statements, procedural flaws, and circumstantial inconsistencies.

06

Bail Advocacy

High-calibre advocacy in pre-trial bail, regular bail, and anticipatory bail across standard and stringent special enactments.

07

Discharge & Framing Arguments

Arguments on discharge under CrPC/BNSS before charge framing where allegations lack prima facie foundation.

08

Evidence Marshalling

Final arguments that synthesize evidentiary exhibits, forensic doubts, and binding High Court and Supreme Court precedents.

CHRONOLOGY

Milestones of Service and Practice

Graduated in commerce and law from Jai Narayan Vyas University, Jodhpur, establishing an enduring academic grounding in law.

POSTINGS

Specialized executive leadership in power distribution enforcement and Anti-Terrorist Squad operational investigations.

2016

PRESENT

Over 11 years of criminal legal practice, advising individuals, fellow advocates, and organisations before the High Court and Sessions Courts.

REGULATORY COMPLIANCE

Non-Solicitation Policy

Compliance with the Bar Council of India Rules under the Advocates Act, 1961.

Statutory Declaration under Rule 36 of the Bar Council of India Rules

Under Rule 36, Section IV, Chapter II, Part VI of the Bar Council of India Rules, Indian advocates and law firms are strictly prohibited from soliciting work or advertising their professional services in any form, direct or indirect.

1. Informational Purpose Only

This website (rkpurilaw.com) is operated solely for the purpose of providing general information regarding the professional background, areas of practice, and team credentials of R.K. Puri Law / Rakesh Puri & Associates. None of the material on this website constitutes legal advice, advertisement, personal communication, solicitation, invitation, or inducement of any sort whatsoever.

2. Voluntary User Access

By accessing this website, the user confirms that:

  • The user is seeking information about R.K. Puri Law of their own accord and volition.
  • There has been no form of solicitation, advertisement, or inducement by R.K. Puri Law or its members.
  • The contents of this website are accessed purely for informational and educational purposes.

3. Absence of Advocate–Client Relationship

Transmission, receipt, or use of this website or sending an enquiry through our contact forms or WhatsApp integration does not create an advocate-client relationship. A formal advocate-client relationship is created exclusively through a written engagement letter, formal vakalatnama, and agreed terms after conflict checks.

4. Consultation Rates & Fee Inquiries

In accordance with Bar Council ethical standards, fees and consultation rates are never published as promotional rates. Consultation fees are confirmed privately upon understanding the scope, documentation, and specific jurisdiction of the matter.

5. Conflict of Interest Checks

Before accepting any brief or entering into professional consultation, R.K. Puri Law conducts mandatory conflict-of-interest checks to ensure adherence to professional ethics.

6. Contact for Verification

If you require information regarding our practice or wish to clarify the scope of our services, you may contact chambers at:
